races.paceDynamic: Pleasant Man is the only horse with any pace-setting inclination, but as a prominent runner rather than confirmed leader, he's likely to set a modest tempo early. With 11 hold-up horses behind him, this will become a slowly-run affair turning into a sprint finish over the final 3 furlongs.

scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian through halfway, creating a cavalry charge finish where the best finisher wins. Latin and One Million Dreams get first run from the pack while others struggle for room.

scenarios.trigger: If Pleasant Man gets an uncontested lead and kicks when pressured
scenarios.body: He steals a march on the field by quickening before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. The closers come late but can't quite reel him in despite the slow early pace.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady but multiple horses get clear runs simultaneously
scenarios.body: Several hold-up horses find racing room at the same time in the straight, creating a blanket finish. Form horses Latin and Volto Di Medusa battle it out with the improving Under The Sun.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Turns Softer
scenarios.trigger: If any rain arrives or the ground rides slower than advertised
scenarios.body: The going-dependent horses suddenly come alive while others struggle with the conditions. Pleasant Man, Latin, and Magic Runner all handle the softer surface better than their rivals.
